csv_project_name: Engineering Svc Install Fire Dampers & Repair Rated Shaft
csv_scope_of_work: This announcement is for the selection of an Engineering Services (ES) Firm to perform design services, technical specifications, working drawings, cost estimates, as-built drawings, construction period services and site-visits for the Altoona VA Project 503- 26-105, Install Fire Dampers and Rated Shafts at the Department of Veterans Affairs, Altoona VA Medical Center located in Altoona, Pennsylvania. The magnitude of Construction for the above referenced project is $8,600,000.00. It is anticipated that a Firm Fixed Price Contract will be awarded to the Engineering Services Firm selected for the aforementioned design services. The most highly qualified Engineering Services firm will be required to participate in a pre-proposal conference prior to submission of the price proposal. Any costs associated with the participation of the pre-proposal conference are not reimbursable.
